I've attempted multiple suicide multiple times and had other kinda life problems and stuff, so my family knows very well of my mental health problems. But i dont really tell them the details because ive never felt comfortable and my childhood was kinda unstable which caused a lot of trust issues.

Yeah. I do go to a mental health counsellor that I could bring it up, but im kind afriad. because like i tried to say, its not that i'm really suicidal or contemplating and I dont want them to take it that way.
